title: OmniTradePro Apex V2.0 — Single Authoritative Statutory & Brokerage Cost Specification

verificationPolicy.rule: Every rate carries a verificationStatus. VERIFIED requires a dated official document stored locally. No locally-supplied official tariff/statutory documents were found during the Phase 1/2 audits, so every statutory and brokerage rate below is UNVERIFIED or an explicitly-labelled modeled construct. Do NOT change any rate value without attaching dated evidence in this file.
verificationPolicy.localEvidenceAssessment: Secondary, undated in-repo narratives. NOT official source documents. Status remains UNVERIFIED.

slippageDefaults.exitBpsPolicy: mirrors entryBps when not explicitly provided
slippageDefaults.note: Not a statutory charge. Two-sided enforcement is mandatory (entry + exit).

NSE_EQ_INTRADAY.idxNote: IDX (spot index) is a non-executable reference feed; costs are modelled with the equity-intraday row as an explicit proxy (status UNVERIFIED).

stt.label: CTT
stt.note: Commodity Transaction Tax (CTT) in place of STT.

NSE_EQ_DELIVERY.reason: No locally-supplied official delivery-rate evidence. The Phase 1 audit found the engine silently applying intraday sell-only STT to delivery product types (defect TAX-001). Per policy the calculation must fail closed instead of inventing or approximating rates.
NSE_EQ_DELIVERY.brokerageNote: Delivery brokerage is documented as INR 0 for all three brokers (still UNVERIFIED).

CDS_ANY.reason: Currency derivatives rate table is absent. Unknown segments must fail closed (Phase 1 finding: they previously fell through to NSE equity rates).

shoonya.label: Shoonya (Finvasia)
shoonya.notes: Flat INR 5 per executed order leg (INR 10 round trip) per the 2026 pricing comment in code; the INR 10 round-trip floor labelled 'Base/API/DP fee' is a modeled construct without citation (Phase 1 TAX-003/004).

angel.label: Angel One SmartAPI
angel.notes: Documented per-leg formula min(INR 20, 0.1% of leg turnover) is overridden by the INR 40 round-trip floor in the current implementation, making the effective model FLAT INR 40 per round trip (Phase 1 TAX-004: the per-leg formula is unreachable for legs <= INR 20). Both models are recorded here; the ACTIVE behaviour is MIN_PER_LEG_WITH_RT_FLOOR as implemented. Changing the active model requires dated broker-tariff evidence.

groww.label: Groww API
groww.notes: Groww charges are modelled identically to Angel One. Phase 1 flagged this as unverified assumption-sharing across brokers (TAX-004 register). Groww-specific heads (if any) are not modelled.

hurdles.note: Policy gates (risk engine), NOT statutory charges. Consolidated in Phase 2 (TAX-005) at the STRICTEST previously-implemented value for each broker so that unification can only tighten, never weaken, order admission.

microCapitalPolicy.note: Phase 1 defect MICRO-001: balances <= INR 2,000 admitted trades with expected NET LOSS up to INR 50. Phase 2 floor is 0 (expected net must be strictly positive after ALL costs). This tightens protection; it cannot be lowered below 0.
